**Answer**

The accrued‑interest component of the $221.9 million redemption was **$13.5 million**.  
To find what fraction of the total redemption this represents:

\[
\text{Fraction} = \frac{\text{Accrued interest}}{\text{Total redemption}}
                 = \frac{13.5\ \text{million}}{221.9\ \text{million}}
                 \approx 0.0609
\]

So, **about 6.1 %** of the total redemption amount was attributable to accrued interest.
